shared_or_similar_visual_information: Parentheses following a name: P(3/5, 4/5) and f(x)
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The parentheses enclose the ordered coordinate pair of P, giving its horizontal and vertical coordinates in that order. Right image: The parentheses specify the input x to function f; f(x) denotes its value.
Rationales: Ordered-pair notation and function-input notation use similar parentheses for different mathematical purposes.
